issue.title: 'eth0' oper down causing BGP default route missing

failure.body:
With a stable system with BGP learnt default route, and oper down of mgmt port (eth0) is causing default route deleted from APP_DB.  This issue is seen on 202205 as well.

Logs:

/var/log/syslog.444.gz:Aug 31 <IPV6>.788610  INFO kernel: [2430739.815597] tg3 <IPV6>.0 eth0: Link is down

swss rec
2022-08-31.<IPV6>.801386|ROUTE_TABLE:<IPV6>::/64|DEL
2022-08-31.<IPV6>.801423|ROUTE_TABLE:<IP>/26|DEL
2022-08-31.<IPV6>.801458|ROUTE_TABLE:<IP>/0|DEL
2022-08-31.<IPV6>.801492|ROUTE_TABLE:::/0|DEL

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Reboot the system with 202205 image
2. Learn BGP default route (<IP>/0) from peers
3. Ensure default route is also present in default table for eth0 ('ip route show table default')
4. Bring down eth0 from management switch (simulate oper-down on DUT)
5. Check for default route in APP_DB.

#### Describe the results you received:
APP_DB default route is removed

#### Describe the results you expected:
APP_DB default route must not be changed during eth0 link-up/down events

resolution.title: [FRR] add patch in zebra to ignore route update on RT_TABLE_DEFAULT
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Arvindsrinivasan Lakshmi Narasimhan <<EMAIL>>

Fixes #11995 and #9188

#### How I did it
Add a patch for zebra to ignore sending netlink messages for routes in the table `RT_DEFAULT_TABLE`
#### How to verify it
Test mentioned in the github issues  #11995 and #9188
